title: hs1 uniformity track pinned at its frontier (GATED): formal/RhAttack/S1Marg.lean - the P1.1e best-straddle margin regime from three certified runs (25 candidate heights in [1e3, 2.8e7]): 25x window up to 1.5e5, >= 13 class to 1e6, >= 1 class to 2.8e7 (min 1.4138), decay order GATED by exact-rational norm_num; the named open face hs1MargFace is the uniform statement itself (b7OpenFace pattern); the 9 higher 'exp' band-scan rows are exploratory and deliberately unpinned
body: FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim): the OPEN piece of the hs1 residual - its uniformity in the witness height (S1Face docstring: 'uniformity in the height is the open measured track, 25x: the P1.1e margin regime') - is now PINNED AT ITS FRONTIER.  MODULE:  formal/RhAttack/S1Marg.lean (namespace S1M; 193 lines; build green in one shot after the anchor fix; full tree re-verified at 17450 jobs, 0 errors; 0 sorry).  THE STATISTIC:  the P1.1e BEST-STRADDLE CLOSURE STATISTIC - the margin of the hs1 composite squeeze |zeta| * min_d |R-1| / (B + |zeta - K|) at the BEST straddle point of the window around the witness height g (the day023 instrument; distinct from the P1.1c worst-over-window margin).  THE DATA (three certified runs, 25 candidate heights):  (1) the 1e7 run (day023_p11e_straddle_1e7.py -> scripts/rh/out_day023_p11e_1e7.txt): 14 candidates [999.7916, 249999.7765], per-t quadrature to 1e18;  (2) the 1e6 extension (day023_p11e_straddle_1e6ext.py -> out_day023_p11e_1e6ext.txt): 4 candidates [299999.7205, 999999.7934];  (3) the (1e7, 1e9] band scan (day023_straddle_hi.py -> out_day023_straddle_hi.txt): the 7 REAL-zero candidates [10000000.24, 28000000.1729] only - dps-30 per-t quadrature, tail = exact discrete sum over 47,517,736 LMFDB zeros in (1e7, 3e7] (shards reach 3.15e7) + density quadrature (3e7, 1e18] + analytic remainder; the 9 higher rows (3.1e7, 3.75e7, 5e7, 7.5e7, 1e8, 1.5e8, 2.5e8, 4e8, 6e8, 1e9 - margins 0.7763, 0.6609, 0.3665, 0.5257, 0.5384, 0.4299, 0.2822, 0.4225, 0.1260, 0.0654, all below 1) are EXPLORATORY (nominal decade points, NOT real zeros, density-only tails) and are DELIBERATELY NOT PINNED - they are the recorded signal that the composite is the limiting object above the certified regime (the repair-list class), never measurements at real zeros.  THE PINS (regime-deciding anchors, exact rationals from the printed 6-significant-figure values, the MFar/B7F pin pattern):  g125 = 125000.3524 / m125 = 28.918 (25x interior); g150 = 150000.2616 / m150 = 38.053 (LAST certified candidate with margin >= 25); g200 = 199999.7053 / m200 = 21.665 (FIRST certified candidate with margin < 25); g250 = 249999.7765 / m250 = 15.504; g1e6 = 999999.7934 / m1e6 = 13.068 (last certified candidate at or below 1e6); g1e7 = 10000000.24 / m1e7 = 5.2362; g2e7 = 19999999.8837 / m2e7 = 1.4138 (the certified MINIMUM margin); g28e7 = 28000000.1729 / m28e7 = 1.7120 (last certified real-zero candidate).  THE GATES (margGates, one norm_num on the pins, all exact rationals):  (i) the 25x WINDOW - m125 >= 25, m150 >= 25, m200 < 25 (the certified 25x regime closes between 1.5e5 and 2e5);  (ii) m250 >= 15 (the >= 15 class survives to 2.5e5);  (iii) m1e6 >= 13 (the >= 13 class to 1e6);  (iv) m1e7 >= 5 and m2e7 >= 1 and m28e7 >= 1 (the >= 1 class to the end of the certified band; min 1.4138 vs threshold 1 - 41% slack against the last printed digit);  (v) the height order g125 < g150 < g200 < g250 < g1e6 < g1e7 < g2e7 < g28e7;  (vi) the DECAY order m125 > m250 > m1e6 > m1e7 > m2e7 - the regime degrades monotonically with height.  THE NAMED FACE (hs1MargFace, declaration, the b7OpenFace pattern):  for ANY zero set q and ANY margin statistic marg (abstract - the statistic itself is data), every height that carries an off-pair zero has marg >= 1.  The pinned gates are the MEASURED SHADOW of the face at the 25 certified candidates; the face itself (uniformity BETWEEN and ABOVE the candidates, including the region where the exploratory exp signal says the composite breaks) is the OPEN measured track of the endpoint's hs1 residual - now pinned at its measured frontier.  ENDPOINT RELATION:  RHEnd.rh_program78 UNTOUCHED; hs1 remains a named residual (read by S1Face.hs1AtZero, closed at the day-020 audited band by S1Face.hs1FaceAtAudit, pin-family form in RHEnd Part B2); S1Marg is a MEASURED CONSTRAINT (PATHWAY section 3): anything that proves RH must reproduce the margin regime.  CARDS:  100 cards / 934 body lines (new card formal/cards/S1Marg.md); _MAP.md carries S1Marg in the spine text and the orphan list; PATHWAY-TO-A-SOLUTION.md carries the GATED paragraph after the route-merge block.  BUILD GOTCHA (recorded):  the printed margin 1.4138 has FOUR decimal places (14138/10000); the first draft pinned it as 14138/1000 = 14.138, which made the decay conjunct m1e7 > m2e7 false (5.2362 < 14.138) - norm_num left exactly the '⊢ False' conjunct; the decimal-place count of each printed value must match its denominator in the pin.  NEXT LEVER candidates:  (a) a second witness-height regime pin for the 1e6-2.8e7 band at the REAL zeros between the 7 candidates (the band is thin: 7 certified heights over 2.7 decades);  (b) B7F consumer wiring (still unconsumed - the 'walk / law-territory' card names predate the current module layout; the P4 tail law is the natural far-side neighbor);  (c) hs3 (the S3 wire) - the other large named residual with no measurement track pinned yet.
